# Thirupathy Bright Industries (Thirupathy Bright Industries)

> Manufacturer of bright and black steel bars in round, square, hexagon and flat profiles, with integrated cold drawing, peeling, centreless grinding, finishing and in-house testing. Operating since 1996. Certified IATF 16949, ISO 14001:2015 and MSME ZED Silver.

Plant: Survey No. 37 & 38, Thadalacherry Village, Gummidipoondi Estate, Thiruvallur Dist., Tamil Nadu 601201, India.
Careers: hr@thirupathybright.com
